scope: Three additive documentary records only. Existing packets and private audit tree preserved. No participant values inspected, no contacts, and no actual version-specific approvals inferred.
negative_control_method: In-memory clones of the parsed acceptance JSON had each of 22 held authority flags flipped to true, then formal rights approval, institutional adoption, reviewer assignment or disposition invented individually. The held-state validator rejected all 26 mutations; no fixture files created.
review_method: Same-agent exact source-to-snapshot string comparison, JSON parsing, byte/SHA-256 verification, explicit content/status checks, in-memory negative controls and preservation scans. Not independent human/institutional review, grant authentication or legal determination.
snapshot_provenance: Complete substantive immediately preceding R11 chat account retained, with historical pending-acceptance question and no-change statement explicitly framed as earlier-turn wording. No platform-authenticated export or message identifier available.

preservation.method: Two complete scans: existing absolute paths sorted case-sensitively; SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation absolute_path TAB byte_length TAB uppercase_file_SHA256 LF. Extended Windows paths used. Count, byte total and digest match in both groups.
preservation.scope_limit: Local pre-existing tracked files and complete prior private audit-local tree only. Opaque hashing did not parse participant values; no data-bearing Git revisions, remote copies, access controls or third-party copies inspected. New records separately hashed outside preservation groups. Audit does not self-hash.

description: Preserve the full consolidated R11 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance dated 25 October 2026.
